title: Title and label of the search palette (opened with Ctrl K). "Socio" is the product name.
description: Screen-reader description of the palette. A socio is an AI agent.
placeholder: Placeholder of the palette's search box.
searching: Shown in the search palette while results from the server are still loading.
nothing: Shown in the search palette when nothing matches what was typed.
corrected: Row offered when the search corrected a typo: <words> wraps the corrected words, shown bold. Keep the tags.
search-instead: Under that row: search for exactly what was typed; {{query}} is the typed text.
new-chat: Palette action: start a conversation with the person's home socio.
theme: Palette action to switch the color theme; {{theme}} is Light, Dark or System.
groups.actions: Group heading in the search palette over commands that do something (for example New chat).
groups.theme: Group heading in the search palette over the color theme choices.
groups.go-to: Group heading of the palette rows that open a module (Go to Chat, Go to Issues…).
groups.apps: Group heading in the search palette over the workspace's added apps and plugins, to open one.
groups.help: Group heading in the search palette over the guides and help.
groups.issues: Group heading in the search palette over matching issues from the Improvements board.
groups.socios: Group heading: the socios (AI agents), to start a chat with one.
groups.rooms: Group heading in the search palette over Rooms (a product noun: chats several people share).
groups.recent-chats: Group heading in the search palette over the person's latest conversations.
groups.spaces: Group heading: Spaces (a product noun: a team's shared area).
groups.pages: Group heading in the search palette over matching pages (documents in Spaces).
